title: Unused Privilege Set
description: Unused-code rule — custom privilege sets assigned to no account (built-in [Full Access] / [Data Entry Only] / [Read-Only Access] are excluded).
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Orphaned privilege sets add security surface and confusion.
rule.remediation: Assign the set where intended, or delete it.
